_comment: Prior-year team name -> current MFL franchise name.
Empty by design. Team-name changes are now handled upstream in the
workbook: a TeamAliases table feeds the AllRosters Power Query, so the
Keeper Info tab already carries current-season names.
This stays as an escape hatch for a name that slips through before the
workbook catches up. Note the converter fails loudly on an unmatched team
either way, so an empty file here does not mean a rename goes unnoticed.
Also read: a 'TeamAliases' sheet in the workbook, which wins over this file.
